description:
[VulnCheck KEV](https://docs.vulncheck.com/community/vulncheck-kev/introduction) is a community catalog of vulnerabilities known to be exploited in the wild. It covers substantially more vulnerabilities than the CISA KEV catalog, and often records exploitation earlier.  

Using it requires a VulnCheck API token. A free community token is sufficient.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the VulnCheck KEV data source should be enabled.

apiUrl.title: API URL
apiUrl.description: Base URL of the VulnCheck API.

apiToken.title: API Token
apiToken.description:
Token to authenticate with the VulnCheck API.  
Create one at [vulncheck.com](https://vulncheck.com/token/newtoken).
